entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Sorry to make work your first activity of[n]the new year.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oh, that reminds me—

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Happy New Year.
Happy New Year.
Hope it'll be good.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: And I hope you'll continue getting along[n]with Futaba and myself.

entries.speaker: Elderly Male Customer
entries.en: We're especially grateful you're open[n]today.

entries.speaker: Elderly Male Customer
entries.en: You know how everything on TV[n]for New Year's is the same old,[n]same old...

entries.speaker: Elderly Female Customer
entries.en: Say, Boss, don't you have any plans[n]for this morning?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I could cook some up, so long as you[n]serve yourself everything and pay[n]your bill on the way out.

entries.speaker: Elderly Male Customer
entries.en: Ah, right, haha. Can't exactly make plans[n]when you've already got customers.

entries.speaker: Elderly Female Customer
entries.en: How about you, young man? Are you[n]going to the shrine for the new year?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: That's a wise choice.

entries.speaker: Studly Guy
entries.en: Happy New Year! That's what you say[n]today, right?
Excuse me, but who're you?
It's nice to meet you.

entries.speaker: Studly Guy
entries.en: Who am I?

entries.speaker: Studly Guy
entries.en: Nice meeting you too— Wait, what[n]are you talking about?

entries.speaker: Studly Guy
entries.en: Are you still half-asleep or something?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Wa-BAM!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oho, lookin' sharp.

entries.speaker: Elderly Female Customer
entries.en: You look absolutely lovely, Futaba-chan.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Heheheh...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I picked it out with my mom.
Your mom?
What did you just say?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Sorry, I don't wanna be late to the shrine.[n]More showing off comes later.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Welp, time to make like a tree!

entries.speaker: Elderly Male Customer
entries.en: The year's first shrine visit, eh? What[n]do you think we should do?

entries.speaker: Elderly Female Customer
entries.en: Well...

entries.speaker: Elderly Female Customer
entries.en: Perhaps we don't need to go this year.

entries.speaker: Elderly Female Customer
entries.en: We don't have any more wishes that[n]need granting.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Sorry, but I think I'll be getting[n]there sooner than I expected.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: It was way less crowded than[n]I thought it would be.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Did my wish actually come true?
You're lucky.
Maybe so.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I'll wait by the entrance[n]once I get there.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Don't worry, no need to hurry!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: What's up? Did you have plans for today[n]or something?
I promised to do something.
Yeah, Meiji Shrine.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Aw, c'mon, you should've just said[n]as much, then. I'll be fine here, so[n]off you go. Have fun.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oh, but it's pretty cold out there, so[n]don't forget to dress warm so you[n]don't catch a bug.
That reminds me, I still haven't seen[n]Morgana today...
...Where could he have gone?
Anyway, I need to head[n]over to Meiji Shrine...
